package consumer_test

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	consumer "example.test/consumer"
	"example.test/consumer/external"
	di "github.com/cratis/fundamentals.go/dependencyinjection"
	"github.com/cratis/fundamentals.go/dependencyinjection/container"
)

func TestForeignConstructorIsDeferredAndResolvesExactGenericKey(t *testing.T) {
	var registry container.Registry
	builder := &registry
	key := external.Box[[]*external.Dependency]{Value: []*external.Dependency{{Value: "foreign"}}}
	if err := di.BindValue(builder, key); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if err := consumer.RegisterServices(builder); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	container, err := builder.Build()
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if external.Calls != 0 { t.Fatal("registration/build activated the constructor") }
	ctx := context.Background()
	defer func() { if err := container.Close(ctx); err != nil { t.Error(err) } }()
	scope, err := container.NewScope(ctx)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	value, err := di.Resolve[*external.Foo](ctx, scope)
	if err != nil || value == nil || value.Value != "foreign" || external.Calls != 1 { t.Fatalf("%+v, %v, calls %d", value, err, external.Calls) }
}
